01 / Current evidence

What exists in the reviewed PR

These original captures come from the attached PR77 UI record at d018a57, captured October 17. They are historical captures of that verified source version, not fresh native screenshots. A fresh browser session was empty; it is shown separately in the screen library.

01Favorites must replace the house concept

Free accounts can save one court; LocalPlus can save multiple and switch between them. A small bracket-and-dot marker is an owner suggestion, not a selected final icon. “Conroe replaces the house” is reopened because the latest favorite idea uses that space. See Q-H1 and Q-H2.

02Move check-in/out back under the metrics

Remove Home’s Plan button and the bottom action stack. Retain navigation to the court; the latest instruction keeps a Court button with a simple arrow. “Small Court action” meant this existing navigation, not a new function. Exact icon/gesture is still open.

03Use the selected understated feed markers

Apply the reference below across the feed event types: small quiet dot, VS and calendar treatment. Do not highlight every row or invent extra orange hues. Preserve useful text and timestamps, with consistent hierarchy for both recent and older checkout events.

04Earlier locked Home structure: Feed + Upcoming

Feed has the active-player row above the activity history. Upcoming uses the selected day timeline of planned visits and scheduled games. Locals belongs on the court page. Later drawer / aggregate-Home ideas remain proposals until an explicit replacement is selected.

05Full-width, dated games; no FAB collision

The offset card squeezed next to the floating + is rejected, as is the hard-to-use horizontal game carousel. Every game must show its date and time. Match the selected Schedule composition, correcting its axes and extending its useful height. Keep planning on Schedule.

What the sketch carries forward

  • Check-in/out sits directly below the metrics.
  • No Plan control or bottom action stack.
  • Court navigation remains available.
  • Full-size h with a visible gap from the number.
  • Active players above a subdued Feed.
  • Feed + Upcoming, with locals on the court page.
  • A favorite-court selector has reserved space; the gesture and final marker are not locked.

What this does not approve

Replacing Home with a drawer, aggregating all favorites by default, adding swipe navigation, or changing free/paid access behavior. Those need their own selected target and domain contract.

Resolve the layout choices below before handing this sketch to an implementation agent.

04 / Continuity and boundaries

Card → drawer → court

Keep the existing Explore card / peeking drawer / expanded drawer progression for the quickest release. The full court page remains the data destination. Changing this architecture is a separate proposal.

05 / Decisions still open

Only the choices we cannot infer

The requests above are already recorded; you do not need to answer them again. Draft answers below stay in this browser until you export and share them. They do not silently become approved decisions.

Choose a dropdown for the first release, swipeable headers, or both. Suggested smallest scope: dropdown first, using the same selected-court behavior on Home and Schedule. Free one / LocalPlus multiple is already recorded.

Proposed: sport left, city right; court name + dropdown below; small bracket-dot favorite marker next to the name. Or put the favorite marker in the top-right and keep city below the name. The old “city replaces house” instruction conflicts with assigning the same position to favorites.

Latest instruction retains the Court button with a simple arrow, so the sketch shows Court ›. Confirm that or choose card/header tap instead. A swipe gesture can be considered separately; it is not implemented or assumed.

Answers are local drafts only.
